an6.74:1.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo paṭhamaṃ ṭhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
an6.74:1.3: kāmavitakkaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ kāmasaññaṃ byāpādasaññaṃ vihiṃsāsaññaṃ
an6.74:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ.
an6.74:2.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ
an6.74:2.3: kāmavitakkaṃ bayāpādavitakkaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ kāmasaññaṃ byāpādasaññaṃ vihiṃsāsaññaṃ
an6.74:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitunti.
